The man looks between the different plates of food offered. (7) The man finally takes a bite of a piece of sushi from the red plate while the woman in the purple top stands next to him. All the characters are smiling or looking at him. The visual composition is centered on the interaction. The objects, including the sushi and plates, are shown in sharp focus with vibrant colors.
